# Quality Pool and Spa

> Quality Pool and Spa provides comprehensive, professional pool and hot tub maintenance, repair, chemical balancing, openings, closings, and equipment upgrades throughout Salt Lake City and the Wasatch Front in Utah.

## Service Overview

- **Routine Cleaning & Maintenance**: Weekly pool and spa cleaning, skimmer and basket emptying, wall brushing, and surface skimming.
- **Water Chemistry & Balancing**: Water chemical analysis, sanitization, pH/alkalinity balancing, and salt water generator cell maintenance.
- **Equipment Diagnosis & Repair**: Diagnostic troubleshooting and repair for pool pumps, variable speed motors, heaters, boilers, automation panels, and leak isolation.
- **Seasonal Pool Openings & Closings**: Professional spring pool openings and winter freeze protection / closing winterization for Utah weather.
- **Spa & Hot Tub Services**: Hot tub electrical diagnostics, jet and pack repairs, cover replacements, winterizations, and leaks.
- **Home Buyer Pool Inspections**: Detailed evaluation of pool equipment, plumbing, and structural condition before buying a home.

## Service Area

- Salt Lake City, Sandy, Draper, South Jordan, West Jordan, Murray, Midvale, Cottonwood Heights, Holladay, Riverton, Herriman, Taylorsville, Bountiful, and Park City, Utah.
